'''2007 Oklahoma State Championship JW Millet DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[JW Millet]] at [[2007 Oklahoma State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' JW Millet III
* '''Deck name:''' Imperial Brokaganda
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
